name: My First Month in a JEE Coaching
source:
Will you spend all your time studying or hanging out with your friends? Will you ace the phase test or drop in school rankings?  Can you go through a month of JEE coaching as you try to balance your studies and sanity?

JEE is the ultimate engineering college entrance exam in India and is given by more than 1,000,000 every year. This highly competitive exam causes students as young as 13 to spend 12+ hours of the day studying.

Spend a month as a student who has moved to a new city away from home to start their 2-year JEE Prep journey. You will meet several friends and discover how this high-pressure society functions. Your actions between studying and relaxing will highly impact your ability to score well in exams, and in turn how society respects you.
translation:
你会把所有的时间都花在学习或和朋友一起出去玩吗？你会在阶段测试中取得好成绩还是在学校排名下降？当你试图平衡你的学习和理智时，你能接受一个月的JEE辅导吗？

JEE是印度最高的工程大学入学考试，每年有超过1,000,000人参加。这项竞争激烈的考试使得年仅13岁的学生每天要花12个小时以上的时间学习。

作为一名搬到远离家乡的新城市的学生，花一个月的时间开始他们为期2年的JEE准备之旅。你会遇到几位朋友，并了解这个高压社会是如何运作的。你在学习和放松之间的行为将极大地影响你在考试中取得好成绩的能力，进而影响社会对你的尊重。
